changes.middle_turn: Unchanged below 3500m; relative amplitude 1 at 3500m, 0.45 at 6000m, zero at 10000m; per-layer background speed preserved.

metric.objects: 8-connected raw threshold mask, no dilation; largest-component centroid, not identity tracking
metric.caveat: Longer pressure forcing is not a guarantee of longer storms at all seeds/thresholds. Sol seed 20261017 peak >=40dBZ span decreased 196 to 168km.

coastal_detail.aggregation: cell mean, height standard deviation, maximum and >50m fraction; peaks are not full-cell walls

rain_grid.method: conservative advected rain-shaft quadrature; bilinear gauge sampling; not resolved grid
